title: Result of config.schema (v1.0): one page of the settings this build has

key.description: A key, or a pattern with one 0-based index written {n}, for example wifi.profile.{n}.ssid.

format.description: A string with a fixed shape. freq,bw,sf,cr: four plain decimals separated by commas, MHz 100-1000, kHz 7-500, spreading factor 5-12, coding rate 5-8; integral values may omit the decimal point. config.get returns what the CLI prints: the frequency at float32 precision (869.618 reads 869.6179809).

write_only.description: A secret: config.get reports "set" or "unset", never the value.

restarts.description: The device restarts itself shortly after the write.

confirm.description: The key can cut its caller's path: any caller but the unsigned cable must send config.apply with confirm (OPERATIONS.md section 3.4).

next.description: Pass as args.cursor for the next page; null on the last page.
